name: ZNetLive
tagline: Budget Indian web host with Plesk hosting, VPS, cloud and domains
description: ZNetLive is a budget Indian web host offering Plesk-based shared hosting, VPS and cloud plans, with a 30-day money-back guarantee and multi-region data centers.
about: ZNetLive is an India-based hosting and domains provider running shared, VPS, cloud and dedicated hosting, alongside domain registration. Its shared hosting lineup is built around three tiers — Starter, Standard and Professional — using Plesk (not cPanel) as the control panel, and it's one of the few budget hosts that lets customers pick a data center region (India, Germany or USA) at signup.

Entry-level shared hosting pricing is aggressive: independent reviews have clocked introductory rates anywhere from under $1 to around $2.24 a month depending on the plan and prepaid term, with the lowest headline numbers tied to longer multi-year commitments rather than a single month. Starter and Standard plans are limited to a single website, while Professional steps up to hosting as many as 15 sites; storage allowance scales with tier, from a capped entry allotment up to unlimited claims on the higher plans. Free SSL and free DDoS protection are included across the shared range.

The renewal jump after the intro term is the thing to plan for — as with most budget hosts, the advertised rate is a promotional price, not a recurring one. ZNetLive backs shared plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, but independent reviewers have flagged friction getting refunds honored when annual licenses aren't cancelled early in the term. Its Trustpilot profile currently sits at a 'Poor' 2.4 out of 5 across 244 reviews, with recurring complaints about support responsiveness — worth weighing against the low sticker price before committing.
policies: ZNetLive offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on shared hosting plans, letting customers request a refund within the first month if the service isn't a fit.

Multiple independent reviews note that refunds can be difficult to secure in practice once a plan has been active for part of its billing term, particularly on annual or multi-year commitments — read the refund terms at checkout carefully before prepaying for a long period.
